mkdir -p "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/design-export"
cat > "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/design-export/plan.txt" << 'PLAN'
## Implementation Plan

Change coder dispatch ordering from codex-first to cursor-first in `review-and-fix.sh` and `lint-fix-loop.sh`, and update their sibling `.md` contract files.

### Files to modify

1. `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.sh` — `run_coder_dispatch()` lines 236-273
2. `scripts/lint-fix-loop.sh` — if/elif dispatch block lines 258-263
3. `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.md` — line 27 ordering description
4. `scripts/lint-fix-loop.md` — step 5 ordering description

### Approach

**review-and-fix.sh `run_coder_dispatch()`**:
- Replace codex-first try with cursor-first: wrap cursor auth setup in an if-guard; on success, acquire cursor serial lock, dispatch cursor; on success return 0
- After the cursor block (whether cursor auth failed or cursor dispatch failed), reset `_SERIAL_LOCK=""`, acquire codex serial lock, dispatch codex; on success return 0
- Final fallback: emit error breadcrumb and return 1

**lint-fix-loop.sh dispatch block**:
- Swap `if [[ "$CODEX_PRESENT" == "true" ]]` and `elif [[ "$CURSOR_PRESENT" == "true" ]]` branches
- Cursor check and `run_cursor` become the primary branch; codex becomes the elif fallback

**Sibling .md files**:
- `review-and-fix.md` line 27: "dispatching Codex, then Cursor" → "dispatching Cursor, then Codex"
- `lint-fix-loop.md` step 5: swap "Dispatch Codex first" to "Dispatch Cursor first … Codex … fallback"

### Edge cases

- When cursor auth setup fails (`cursor_launcher_load_model_args` or `cursor_launcher_setup_auth_argv` returns non-zero), the cursor block is skipped silently and codex is tried — no error breadcrumb until both fail. This matches the existing `ship-pr.sh` cursor-first pattern.
- `test-review-and-fix.sh` `codex-success` case: cursor auth succeeds (CURSOR_API_KEY is set), cursor stub returns 1 (default case for `codex-success:cursor`), codex succeeds → `CODER_TOOL=codex` unchanged.
- `test-lint-fix-loop.sh` cases all use `CURSOR_PRESENT=false` → cursor branch is skipped, codex branch runs as before.

### Verification

Run `/relevant-checks` which includes:
- `test-review-structure.sh` — checks both `--tool codex` and `--tool cursor` are present in review-and-fix.sh
- `test-review-and-fix.sh` — the full dispatch harness including codex-success, cursor-success, all-fail
- `test-lint-fix-loop.sh` — verifies the dispatch ordering
PLAN

cat > "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/design-export/voting-tally.md" << 'TALLY'
Quick mode — no plan review voting.
TALLY

Change coder dispatch ordering in review-and-fix.sh and lint-fix-loop.sh from codex-first to cursor-first. In review-and-fix.sh, rewrite run_coder_dispatch() to attempt cursor first (cursor_launcher_load_model_args + cursor_launcher_setup_auth_argv + run-external-agent.sh --tool cursor), then fall back to codex if cursor fails or auth setup fails. In lint-fix-loop.sh, swap the if/elif block so CURSOR_PRESENT is checked first, CODEX_PRESENT second. Update sibling docs: review-and-fix.md ("dispatching Codex, then Cursor" → "dispatching Cursor, then Codex") and lint-fix-loop.md step 5 (same ordering flip). ship-pr.sh is already cursor-first and needs no change.
FEAT

export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
RUN_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"

# Use the review-round-summary and rejected findings as the body
{
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/review-round-summary.md" ]; then
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/review-round-summary.md"
  else
    printf 'Review-and-fix loop completed (round 1: 2 accepted, 4 rejected).\n'
  fi
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/rejected-findings.md" ]; then
    printf '\n\n## Rejected Code Review Findings\n\n'
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/rejected-findings.md"
  fi
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/voting-tally.md" ]; then
    printf '\n\n## Voting Tally\n\n'
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/voting-tally.md"
  fi
} > "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-log-batches-input/code-review-tally-body.md"

<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/scripts/write-tally.sh \
  --log-root "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-logs" \
  --skill implement \
  --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
  --phase code-review \
  --mode simple \
  --rounds 1 \
  --accepted 2 \
  --rejected 4 \
  --exonerated 2 \
  --neutral 4 \
  --body-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-log-batches-input/code-review-tally-body.md"

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
RUN_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"

# Strip disallowed headers from review summary
{
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/review-round-summary.md" ]; then
    grep -v '^#' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/review-round-summary.md" || true
  fi
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/rejected-findings.md" ]; then
    printf '\n## Rejected Code Review Findings\n\n'
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/rejected-findings.md"
  fi
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/voting-tally.md" ]; then
    printf '\n## Voting Tally\n\n'
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/round-1/voting-tally.md"
  fi
} > "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-log-batches-input/code-review-tally-body.md"

<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/scripts/write-tally.sh \
  --log-root "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-logs" \
  --skill implement \
  --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
  --phase code-review \
  --mode simple \
  --rounds 1 \
  --accepted 2 \
  --rejected 4 \
  --exonerated 2 \
  --neutral 4 \
  --body-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-log-batches-input/code-review-tally-body.md"

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
RUN_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"

# Compose review-findings-full
"<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/scripts/compose-review-findings.sh" \
    --design-artifacts-dir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/design-export" \
    --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
    --issue "2445" \
    --output "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/review-findings-full.jsonl" && \
<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/scripts/larch-log.sh write \
    --log-root "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-logs" \
    --skill implement \
    --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
    --batch review-findings-full \
    --input-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/review-findings-full.jsonl" || \
    echo "WARN: review-findings-full compose/write failed"

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"
export LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/claude-source.env"
export LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/timing-ledger.tsv"

touch "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/.review-boundary-passed"

<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/skills/implement/scripts/check-review-changes.sh \
  --baseline "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/pre-review-untracked.txt" \
  --head-baseline "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/pre-review-head.txt"

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"
export LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/claude-source.env"
export LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/timing-ledger.tsv"

git -C /Users/zhupanov/larch3 status --short

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"
export LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/claude-source.env"
export LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/timing-ledger.tsv"

# Check changed files count
MERGE_BASE=$(git -C /Users/zhupanov/larch3 merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || MERGE_BASE=""
if [ -n "$MERGE_BASE" ]; then
  CHANGED_FILES=$(git -C /Users/zhupanov/larch3 diff --name-only "${MERGE_BASE}..HEAD" 2>/dev/null)
  CHANGED_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -c . 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
else
  CHANGED_COUNT=0
fi
echo "CHANGED_COUNT=$CHANGED_COUNT"
echo "$CHANGED_FILES"
input.description: Check changed file count for code flow skip decision

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41"
ISSUE_NUMBER="2445"
RUN_ID="8875C3CC-EB58-4C94-AD71-4996A1E793C2"
ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM_FILE=""

{
  if [ -n "${ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM_FILE:-}" ]; then
    cat "$ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM_FILE"
  else
    printf 'Architecture diagram not available.'
  fi
  printf '\n\n'
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/code-flow-diagram.md" ]; then
    cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/code-flow-diagram.md"
  else
    printf 'Code flow diagram not available.'
  fi
} > "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/summary-diagrams.md"

<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/29.8.41/scripts/tracking-issue-summary.sh upsert-summary \
  --issue "$ISSUE_NUMBER" \
  --marker "<!-- larch:diagrams v1 runid=$RUN_ID -->" \
  --content-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/summary-diagrams.md" || true
